# r/DetroitPistons (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** The Last of His Kind: For ten seasons no player who refused to shoot threes was in the top ten, until Jalen Duren

**Body:**

Every other player in our top ten took at least 22% of his shots from three. Jalen Duren took none, and still graded 7th in the league per minute. The first top-ten non-shooter in ten years.

In 2004–05 four of the top ten never shot threes, Kevin Garnett first among them. From 2015–16 through 2024–25 the count was zero.

He was first in efficiency under load among 164 players with 1,500 minutes. The playoffs are why The 644 ranks him 14th, and the charge expires with the next postseason.

Our calls, registered before tip-off and graded in public:
80%  He stays top 15 in The 644
60%  He posts the best BPM among traditional centers

Full article (free, no ads): https://thegravityreport.com/notes/duren/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
